name: agentlayer
description: An agent that remembers your work, in a folder you own. It captures every session, compiles what it learned into plain markdown, and loads it back before you type. Tasks, briefings, a dashboard, and packs for GitHub, databases, support desks, SEO and a browser. All data stays local.

interface.longDescription: Your agent keeps a local markdown brain: identity files, a compiled wiki, active memory, and a task system. Every session is captured and compiled back into that brain, so the next session, in Codex or Claude Code, picks up where the last one left off.
defaultPrompt: Who are you and what's on my task list?
